meta.name: diagnose
meta.description: Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Reproduce → minimise → hypothesise → instrument → fix → regression-test. Use when user says "diagnose this" / "debug this", reports a bug, says something is broken/throwing/failing, or describes a performance regression.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 系统化诊断并修复复杂 bug 和性能退化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面对难以定位的 bug 或性能退化问题
copy.tagline_en: Systematically diagnose and fix hard bugs and performance regressions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face hard-to-diagnose bugs or performance regressions

howto.what: Claude 会按照一套严谨的流程来诊断难以复现的 bug 或性能回退：先构建一个快速、确定的反馈循环来复现问题，然后生成多个可证伪的假设，逐一通过工具或日志验证，最后修复并添加回归测试。
howto.when: 当你说“诊断这个”、“调试这个”，或报告某个东西坏了、抛异常、失败，或描述性能回退时触发。

say.text: 诊断这个：用户登录后页面加载慢了三倍。
say.note: Claude 会开始构建反馈循环并逐步排查。

say.text: 调试这个：点击提交按钮后控制台报错。
say.note: Claude 会尝试复现并定位错误原因。

say.text: 这个接口偶尔返回 500 错误，帮我查一下。
say.note: Claude 会尝试提高复现率并分析。

howto.what_en: Claude follows a disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions: build a fast, deterministic feedback loop to reproduce the issue, generate multiple falsifiable hypotheses, instrument to test each, fix, and add a regression test.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "diagnose this" / "debug this", report a bug, say something is broken/throwing/failing, or describe a performance regression.

say_en.text: Diagnose this: user login page loads 3x slower.
say_en.note: Claude will start building a feedback loop and investigate.

say_en.text: Debug this: clicking submit button throws console error.
say_en.note: Claude will attempt to reproduce and locate the error cause.

say_en.text: This API occasionally returns 500, please investigate.
say_en.note: Claude will try to increase reproduction rate and analyze.
